## What's Changed
* ci: npm への公開を Trusted Publishing（OIDC）に切り替える by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1038


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3

## What's Changed
* fix #227: strictの単色ベタ塗り比較をwarningsで通知する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/368
* fix #229: ignore_regionに小数値を受け付ける by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/369
* fix #231: aHashグリッド定数をcomparatorに一元化する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/370
* fix #230: layout_tree応答にcount_extra_webをechoする by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/371
* fix #232: WebP画像入力に対応する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/372
* fix #233: 合否判定を表示桁の一致率に揃える by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/373
* fix #235: layout_treeのdetailsで不一致を一致ペアより先に返す by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/374
* fix #234: 除外した親の子が絶対座標比較に落ちないようにする by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/375
* fix #236: layout_tree応答にmismatched_nodesを追加 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/376
* fix #240: perceptualの0次元画像チェックをcomparatorに一元化する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/380
* fix #243: MCP初期化応答にモード選択指針を追加 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/381
* fix #228: compare_designの結果をstructuredContentでも返す by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/367
* fix #238: layout_treeの空入力を全件除外と誤報しない by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/379
* fix #245: MITライセンスのLICENSEファイルを追加 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/382
* fix #244: perceptualのサイズ差ignore_regionをwarningsで通知する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/383
* fix #249: 非文字列のmodeで誤ったrequiredエラーを返さない by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/384
* fix #248: layout_tree応答に除外ノード一覧ignored_nodesを含める by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/385
* fix #250: getFigmaRelativeCoordsの古い仮想キャンバス比コメントを実態に合わせて修正する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/386
* fix #253: perceptual応答に不一致セルの範囲diff_regionを含める by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/387
* fix #269: layout_tree 不一致詳細に絶対 BBox を含める by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/388
* fix #273: DecodeConfig でヘッダ寸法を事前検査して圧縮爆弾の OOM を防ぐ by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/389
* fix #275: 無効なignore_regionをunmatched_ignore_regionsで報告する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/390
* fix #283: 未使用の EnsureSameSize を非公開化する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/391
* fix #282: layout_tree の不一致を mismatched_pairs で返す by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/392
* fix #287: PNG/GIFのヘッダ寸法チェックをデコード前に追加 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/393
* fix #290: READMEに画像の最大寸法8192px制限を記載する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/394
* fix #289: strictのmin_match単独指定時にmax_diff_pixels既定0の罠をdetailsとSKILLへ明示する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/395
* fix #293: パディングなし・空白混じり base64 を受け付ける by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/396
* fix #306: layout_treeの必須フィールド欠落・空識別子を入力エラーにする by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/397
* fix #305: ignore_region未指定時はサイズ不一致noteを出さない by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/398
* fix #308: diff_imageの言及をperceptual/strictモードに限定する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuc

issues.title: ignore_nodes のカンマ分割処理が layout_tree と layout_integrity で重複している
layout_integrity の応答に除外ノード一覧 (ignored_nodes) が無く、除外の過剰一致を検証できない
型違いの ignore_nodes / ignore_region / viewport_preset / diff_on_mismatch が黙って既定値に落ちる
CLI: 非フラグ引数より後ろのフラグが黙って無視され、--generate-diff false などが効かない
ignore_nodes のカンマ分割処理が layout_tree と layout_integrity で二重実装されている
main.go が gofmt 未整形で、CI にフォーマット検査が無い
